subject: food-technology
title: Dry Cooking
welcome_lead: Bake, roast, grill, fry — cooking without much water.
final_note: Dry heat browns and crisps food.

concepts.def: Quick frying in wok with little oil.

walkthroughs.body_html: Baking is oven heat with no fat — cakes, bread, biscuits. Roasting adds some oil or fat — meat, potatoes. Both run around 180-220°C.
Grilling uses fierce heat from above — gives a brown, crisp top. Great for cheese, toast, sausages. Watch carefully — easy to burn.
Frying in hot oil cooks fast and adds crunch. Stir-frying uses high heat and tiny amounts of oil in a wok — keeps veg crunchy. Caramelisation = sugars browning for flavour.
